projects.title: BerkeleyNano3D
projects.description:
Ballistic quantum transport simulator with the following features:
- Non-equilibrium Green's function solver
- 3D finite element Poisson solver with automatic interpolation to/from atomistic grids
- Built for simulating carbon nanotube and graphene nanoribbon MOSFET and TFET devices
- Lua-based scripting for highly configurable simulations
- MPI parallelism for running on 1000s of CPU cores simultaneously
- Code written in C++ with the Eigen template library
